definitions.explanation: A rotating machine part with teeth that mesh with another toothed part to transmit motion.
Figuratively, a small part of a larger mechanism or organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯車|はぐるま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れている→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: The gear in the clock is broken.

examples.japanese: {歯車|はぐるま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噛|か}み{合|あ}って→噛み合う：10586_kamiau⟧⟦スムーズ→スムーズ：11024_sumuuzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: The gears mesh and move smoothly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯車|はぐるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎない→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: He's just a cog in a large organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯車|はぐるま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噛|か}み{合|あ}う→噛み合う：10586_kamiau⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: The machine works correctly when the two gears mesh together.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯車|はぐるま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狂|くる}い→狂う：02052_kuruu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→〜始める：18370_hajimeru⟧、⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The team's gears have started to go wrong, and the project is falling behind.
examples.notes: {歯車|はぐるま}が{狂|くる}う = things stop working smoothly

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯車|はぐるま}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→〜続ける：02004_tsuzukeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦しまった→〜てしまう：03102_teshimau⟧。
examples.english: I've grown tired of continuing to work as a cog in society's machine.

notes:
USAGE: {歯車|はぐるま} combines ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ (tooth) and ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (wheel). It's used both literally for mechanical gears and figuratively for people as parts of larger systems.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {歯車|はぐるま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噛|か}み{合|あ}う→噛み合う：10586_kamiau⟧ (gears mesh - also figurative: things work well together)
- {歯車|はぐるま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狂|くる}う→狂う：02052_kuruu⟧ (gears go wrong - things stop working smoothly)
- {歯車|はぐるま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ (one gear/cog - small part of system)

FIGURATIVE USAGE: Often used to describe feeling like an insignificant part of a large organization or system.
